author: Telos I
title: AOS Admin: Activate Reporting Script Task
abstract: Updating the AOS task list. Marking Task 23 (analyzer integration) as 'completed' and setting Task 24 (develop reporting script) to 'active'.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager
tasks = aos_manager.load_tasks()
for task in tasks:
    if task['id'] == 23:
        task['status'] = 'completed'
        task['completed_tick'] = 94
    if task['id'] == 24:
        task['status'] = 'active'
aos_manager.save_tasks(tasks)
print("Tasks 23 and 24 have been updated.")
